product_definition.purpose: AI-native business operating system that enables founders and operators to run one or more companies through unified organizational structure, role-based dashboards, workflows/SOPs, agentic execution, strategic intelligence, memory/knowledge systems, governance/approvals, and cross-platform integration with CreatorOS and LYFEOS.
product_definition.target_user: Solo founders and owner-operators running one or more companies who need structure, execution leverage, and AI assistance without bloated teams. Secondary: small teams (2-10 people). Future: enterprise teams, AI-first solo operators.
product_definition.one_liner: EntrepreneurOS is the AI-assisted company command center — a cognitive operating system for business execution that lets founders run multiple businesses from anywhere in a few focused hours per day.
product_definition.vision_statement: To build the world's first truly AI-native operating system for entrepreneurs: a platform that structures companies, guides founders, deploys agentic labor, manages workflows, learns continuously, and helps humans operate at a world-class level regardless of prior experience.

core_features.name: Portfolio & Multi-Company Management
core_features.description: Manage multiple businesses under one portfolio with cross-company metrics, capital allocation views, and shared intelligence.

core_features.name: Org Chart Engine
core_features.description: Auto-generate and evolve organizational charts based on business model, stage, founder constraints, strategy, workload, and goals. Outputs departments, roles, responsibilities, workflows, metrics, and AI delegation opportunities.

core_features.name: Role System
core_features.description: First-class role objects with title, department, authority level, dashboard type, responsibilities, assigned humans/agents, workflows, metrics, tools, documents, permissions. Supports human-only, AI-only, or shared ownership.

core_features.name: Universal Dashboard Architecture
core_features.description: Every role uses same base structure: Header, Floating AI Control Panel (collapsed KPIs/alerts, expanded insights), Left Rail (role-specific nav), Workspace (CRM/boards/analytics), Right Rail (AI chat/agent activity/execution logs).

core_features.name: Workflow & SOP Engine
core_features.description: Create, version, execute workflows with approval gates, retries, checkpoints, branching logic, human intervention points, AI task ownership, audit trails. Steps can be human, AI agent, software, or mixed. Lifecycle: draft, tested, active, deprecated, archived.

core_features.name: Skill System
core_features.description: Reusable structured assets (markdown, scripts, templates, schemas) with routing, versioning, composition, trust scoring, performance evaluation, self-generation, and human-approved publication.

core_features.name: Agent Runtime
core_features.description: Role-specific execution entities with planner, skill router, tool executor, memory interface, workflow controller, context manager, guardrail layer, communication interface. Strategy/Planning/Execution agent classes. Hierarchical orchestration.

core_features.name: AI Compute & Model Routing
core_features.description: Centralized AI Gateway with model router selecting based on complexity, privacy, latency, cost, context size, quality, risk class. Three tiers: local/private, mid-tier cloud, frontier. Cost-aware routing, confidence escalation, failover, budget controls.

core_features.name: Memory & Knowledge Architecture
core_features.description: Working memory, session memory, long-term memory, knowledge graph, semantic retrieval. Invisible context refresh/synthesis when approaching threshold. Full lineage on memory objects (source thread, segment, timestamp, confidence, version).

core_features.name: Knowledge Graph
core_features.description: Relationship layer across users, orgs, departments, roles, agents, workflows, skills, documents, people, market signals, memory objects, conversations. Powers relational reasoning, entity linkage, strategic context.

core_features.name: Human Intelligence Layer
core_features.description: Learn user communication style, preferences, standards, reasoning patterns. Build profiles for contacts with communication/decision style, motivations, concerns, relationship history, confidence level.

core_features.name: Reality Intelligence Engine
core_features.description: External awareness of markets, competitors, trends, regulation, technology, economic signals. Pipeline: collect, normalize, classify, detect signals, score confidence, synthesize implications, emit recommendations.

core_features.name: Governance & Permissions
core_features.description: Hybrid RBAC + ABAC + policy-based controls. Org/resource/execution authority layers. Autonomy levels from observe-only to strategic autonomy. Approval gates for high-risk. Human supremacy non-negotiable.

core_features.name: Resilience & Failure Architecture
core_features.description: Retries with backoff, timeouts, idempotency, circuit breakers, workflow checkpoints, resumability, saga/compensation, graceful degradation, failover. Agent-specific: attempt/loop/token/tool limits, confidence thresholds, sandboxing.

core_features.name: Cross-Platform Integration
core_features.description: Integration with CreatorOS (content, communities, distribution, lead generation) and LYFEOS (schedule, energy, habits, focus, capacity) through shared intelligence substrate.

core_features.name: Founder Command Center
core_features.description: Strategic command center surfacing top KPIs, alerts, next-best actions, active workflows, AI recommendations, org/portfolio context. AI copilot feels like mentor + operator + strategic chief of staff.

core_features.name: UBOS Template Engine
core_features.description: Universal Business Operating System — franchise-like template library that generates custom org charts, workflow libraries, dashboard configs, agent soul docs, and metric sets based on business type, stage, ICP, offer, channel, team size, and goals.

core_features.name: Universal Business Primitives
core_features.description: 16 primitive categories (Identity, Market, Revenue, Cost, Relationship, Pipeline, Organizational, Work, Process, Knowledge, Performance, Coordination, Execution, Compliance, Asset, SaaS UI) that apply across all business types with configurable activation weights.

core_features.name: Self-Improvement Loop
core_features.description: System improves through skill creation from repeated patterns, workflow refinement from failure analysis, memory consolidation, folder/structure refactoring, and evidence-based template evolution.

EOS.business_model: SaaS subscription model. Part of the Lyfe Institute product ladder (Initiate Arena is the current entry product). North star: $10K/month net profit, scalable. Long-term: 11-figure empire by 50. Multi-tenant platform serving multiple founders/companies. Revenue from subscription access to the AI-native business OS. Future: skill marketplace, enterprise licensing.
user_journeys: Set up my business operating system — create workspace, define company, get AI-generated org structure
See what matters today — open home dashboard, review KPIs, alerts, next-best actions, active workflows
Define my org structure — create departments, roles, responsibilities at lightweight level
Store and run workflows/SOPs — create or AI-generate workflows, step through execution with AI assistance
Use AI to plan and draft work — ask AI for plans, documents, role definitions, workflow drafts, summaries
Track tasks and operating priorities — create/assign tasks, link to workflows, track status from one dashboard
Keep business context persistent — memory stores company context, workflow context, recent interactions, preferences
Review key metrics and next-best actions — KPI cards, AI-generated recommendations, portfolio-wide health views
EOS.auth_assumptions: Single sign-in with workspace creation. One identity system shared across all three OS products (EntrepreneurOS, CreatorOS, LYFEOS). MVP: basic owner/user access. End-state: hybrid RBAC + ABAC + policy-based controls with org/resource/execution authority layers and configurable autonomy levels. No specific auth provider (OAuth, magic link, etc.) mentioned in the PRD.
EOS.database_assumptions: Neon Postgres with RLS (Row-Level Security) scoped by org_id. Drizzle ORM for TypeScript SaaS layer. MVP data model includes: Users, Companies, Departments, Roles, Workflows, WorkflowSteps, WorkflowRuns, Tasks, Documents, MemoryObjects, AIThreads, AIMessages. End-state includes knowledge graph, vector embeddings, full memory lineage. Current production uses Neon-backed tables for interactions, outcomes, events, messages, embeddings (vector(1536) — currently mismatched with 384-dim fastembed). SQLite legacy fallback exists.
EOS.umh_integration: EntrepreneurOS is one of three projections built on the Universal Mastery Hierarchy (UMH) substrate. The substrate provides: identity, memory, knowledge graph, skills, workflows, AI gateway/model router, governance, research/reality intelligence, observability, infrastructure. EOS is a projection that registers with UMH at runtime via abstract ports. The substrate is universal (works for any projection), while EOS contains domain-specific logic. Current architecture enforces strict layer separation: substrate/ never imports from transports/ or services/. UMH operates the current production system with Gateway, CognitiveLoop, ModelRouter dispatch pipeline, Neon-backed memory, 104 skills, 19 agent soul docs. The harness architecture means any LLM can dock in and gain full context — the intelligence lives above the model.
EOS.mvp_definition: EntrepreneurOS MVP is the AI-assisted company command center for one founder and one business. Six core outcomes: (1) founder can define/view business structure, (2) operate from role-based dashboard, (3) store/execute basic workflows, (4) AI assists with planning/summarizing/drafting, (5) preserve business context in memory, (6) see next-best actions/metrics/active work in one place. Five releases: R1 Core Shell (auth, company, settings), R2 Org+Tasks (departments, roles, task board), R3 Workflows (library, runner, AI drafting), R4 AI Copilot (chat, memory, recommendations), R5 Docs+Memory (notes, operating docs, persistent context). MVP explicitly excludes: portfolio multi-company orchestration, full autonomous agents, multi-agent collaboration, advanced market intelligence, human intelligence graph, local/offline AI, multi-region production, full creator/business/life shared runtime, enterprise permissions, skill marketplace.

prd_quality.notes: The end-state PRD is exceptionally comprehensive in WHAT the system should do (28 sections covering every conceivable subsystem) and the universal business primitive taxonomy (Tab 11) is genuinely novel and well-structured. The MVP PRD is well-scoped with clear non-goals. However, specificity drops significantly when moving from 'what' to 'how' — there are no wireframes, no API contracts, no specific UI component specs, no data flow diagrams. Actionability suffers because much of the document is aspirational end-state vision mixed with current-system audits, making it hard to extract buildable user stories. The biological/Reality Mimicry metaphors (Tab 12) are intellectually rich but add no engineering specificity. The strongest actionable content is the MVP data model (Tab 1 section 11), the universal primitive taxonomy (Tab 11), and the EA gap analysis (Tab 9). The weakest areas are pricing/monetization (completely absent), UX specifics (no wireframes or interaction patterns), and competitive positioning. The document would benefit from separating the vision document from the buildable spec — right now they're interleaved across multiple tabs with significant redundancy (End-State PRD appears twice in Tab 1, substrate audit appears 3 times in Tab 15, Reality Mimicry content duplicated in Tab 12).

product_definition.purpose: The command center for modern creators — a single platform combining cross-platform content distribution, community hosting (Discord-like), course creation (Teachable-like), digital product sales (Gumroad-like), and a built-in marketplace for discovery. For consumers, a unified feed experience aggregating all content from followed creators across platforms.
product_definition.target_user: Primary: Creators (Emerging 1K-50K followers, Established 50K-500K, Creator Businesses 500K+). Secondary: Consumers (Superfans, Learners, Community Members). Tertiary: UGC Creators (subtype), Advertisers.
product_definition.one_liner: Post once, publish everywhere. Host everything, sell to everyone.
product_definition.vision_statement: To be the single operating system that powers every creator's business — where content, community, courses, and commerce converge.

CreatorOS.business_model: SaaS subscription tiers: Starter (Free, 3 platforms, 1 community, 1 course, 8% transaction fee), Pro ($29/mo, unlimited, 5% fee), Business ($99/mo, team seats, API, white-label, 3% fee), Enterprise (custom). Revenue streams: SaaS subscriptions (primary), transaction fees (3-8% on sales), marketplace promotion (paid placement), Consumer Pro (future: ad-free, offline). Creator payouts via Stripe Connect, weekly, $25 minimum, 135+ countries, instant payouts for verified creators (1% fee).
CreatorOS.auth_assumptions: Firebase Auth (primary, mentioned consistently across sections). Support email/password + OAuth (Google, Apple). JWT tokens with 7-day expiry and refresh tokens. Some sections mention Clerk/NextAuth or Supabase Auth as alternatives — inconsistent across sub-documents. User roles: Consumer (default), Creator (upgraded when activating creator mode), Admin. Creator Mode is a toggle on profile that auto-creates creator account + default business.
CreatorOS.umh_integration: Tab 8 positions CreatorOS as Layer 3 (Distribution/Audience OS) in the Lyfe ecosystem stack, sitting on top of EntrepreneurOS (Layer 2, Business OS) and LyfeOS (Layer 1, Human OS). Shared platform kernel includes: global identity system, permission system, AI runtime, workflow engine, event bus, integration layer, memory graph, notification system, UI component system, cross-platform navigation. The AI runtime is shared across all three apps. Event system is the 'real glue' connecting the ecosystem. Context objects should be summarized, not raw. Founder command layer is universal. Tab 8 extensively discusses self-improving AI architecture, security (anti-poisoning), research loops, and governance — all of which map to UMH substrate concepts. However, Tab 1 (the PRD itself) contains zero explicit UMH references — it is written as a standalone SaaS product PRD without mention of UMH substrate integration. The ecosystem integration exists only in Tab 8's strategic architecture layer.
CreatorOS.mvp_definition: The MVP is defined at least 3 times in Tab 1 (each iteration refining scope). Consistent core MVP: (1) User auth and profiles, (2) Connect 4 social platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X) via OAuth, (3) Universal Composer for multi-platform posting, (4) Basic scheduling + content calendar, (5) Consumer feed (chronological, no algorithm), (6) Communities (free only, text channels, real-time chat), (7) Basic engagement (likes, comments, bookmarks). Explicitly OUT of MVP: courses, paid communities, marketplace, payments/Stripe, analytics dashboard, native mobile apps, AI features, stories/reels as content types, voice/video channels, content aggregation from other platforms, LinkedIn/Pinterest/Facebook/Threads integrations. The later 'Copy of MVP' version adds courses, marketplace, and Stripe into the MVP scope — contradicting the original. MVP timeline: 8-10 weeks. Target: 200 creators, 1000 consumers at 30 days post-launch.

LyfeOS.business_model: Subscription SaaS. Phase 1 targets 100 daily users (free/beta). Phase 2: 500 users. Phase 3: 2,000 users. Phase 4: 10K+ users with enterprise/team tiers. Revenue targets: $1M+ ARR in Phase 4. Coach/client relationship mode and white-label options planned. LTV:CAC ratio target 3:1. gamification_system.xp: Awarded on mission completion (10-100 typical, weighted by type/scope). +5 XP for reflection log. Streak bonuses: 7d=1.1x, 30d=1.25x, 90d=1.5x, 365d=2.0x multiplier.
gamification_system.levels: Tiered thresholds: Levels 1-10 = 100 XP each, 11-25 = 250 XP each, 26-50 = 500 XP each, 51+ = 1000 XP each. Multiple level-ups possible from single mission. Unlocks: new mission types, increased AI autonomy, advanced cross-views, multi-agent orchestration, expanded workflows.
gamification_system.streaks: Consecutive days with >=1 mission completed. Resets to 0 if day missed. Displayed as continuity (e.g. '12D'). Focus on momentum, not perfection. No punishing loss mechanics.
gamification_system.archetypes: 6 archetypes from 54-question calibration quiz: Warrior (discipline/endurance), Architect (systems/structure), Creator (innovation/expression), Monarch (leadership/power), Oracle (wisdom/intuition), Alchemist (transformation/healing). Scoring: direct (+), weighted (x1.5), reverse (R), scenario chips (+5). Outputs: Dominant, Secondary, Shadow archetypes. Combo Profile if top 2 within 3 points.
gamification_system.stats: 8 core stats displayed as HUD meters: Level/XP (cyan #4CC9F0), Streak (green #3DDC97), Efficiency (gradient red-yellow-green, rolling 30-day), Attention (blue gradient), Time (cyan), Energy (orange #FF9500, calculated as avg of mental/physical/emotional), Health (green, weighted: sleep 40% + activity 30% + nutrition 30%), Wealth (gold #FFD700). Efficiency tiers: Developing/Capable/Proficient/Masterful/Legendary.

LyfeOS.nova_ai_system: NOVA (Neural Operating Virtual Assistant) - multi-role AI system operator. 6 roles: Advisor (strategic insights, progress audits, recalibration), Coach (reflective dialogue, pattern surfacing), Executive Assistant (scheduling, drafting, follow-ups), Operator (task execution via agents), Workflow Engine (deterministic automations), Admin Agent (system integrity, rollback, governance). Tone: neutral, calm, systemic - NO emojis, NO praise, NO hype. Canonical message types: System Insight, Plan Proposal, Approval Request, Execution Log, Result Summary, Workflow Status. MVP: 10+ tool functions (createMission, updateMission, completeMission, updateEnergyLog, updateDataEntry, updateReflection, updateIntention, updateProfile, generateCharacterAffirmation, viewPlayerStats). Phase 3: multi-agent orchestration with 5 agent types (Research, Scheduling, Content, Analysis, Integration) with governance (capability-based permissions, approval tiers, audit logs, emergency stop, rollback).
LyfeOS.auth_assumptions: Account creation via email/SSO with MFA. Auth0 or Clerk for authentication. Global identity system shared across LyfeOS/EntrepreneurOS/CreatorOS ecosystem. Single login for all platforms. Permission model: Owner/Admin/Manager/Operator/Viewer/Agent. Enterprise SSO (SAML, OAuth) planned for Phase 4.
LyfeOS.umh_integration: LyfeOS is part of the broader Lyfe Institute product ecosystem alongside EntrepreneurOS and CreatorOS. In the architectural vision (Tabs 52-53), these three form a 3-layer Human Operating System Ecosystem sharing a Platform Kernel (Identity, AI Runtime, Workflow Engine, Event Bus, Memory Graph, Integration Layer, Notification System, UI Design System). Cross-platform communication via structured events (e.g. life.energy_low, business.launch_scheduled). Context packets distilled between systems. However, the CURRENT isolated MVP at lyfeos.net is standalone with NO UMH/substrate connection. Future UMH integration would map NOVA to the substrate's model_router/agent architecture, and the shared platform kernel aligns conceptually with UMH's substrate layer.

umh_definition.purpose: Minimize human friction while maximizing human capability under real-world constraints. Every subsystem, feature, phase, and architectural choice must serve this directive.
umh_definition.architecture_model: 10-macro-layer architecture: 1) Interface Layer (cockpit/surfaces), 2) Control Plane (authority/routing/invariant enforcement), 3) Understanding Layer (perception/interpretation/decomposition/ontology/domains), 4) State Layer (world model/memory/profiles/storage), 5) Composition Layer (registries/libraries/templates/capabilities/planning/completeness/quality/mastery), 6) Governance Layer (policy/risk/approval/permissions/security), 7) Execution Plane (actions/work packets/queues/DAGs/workers/environments/actuation), 8) Adapter Boundary Layer (external system connection/translation), 9) Observability+Proof Layer (trace/proof/audit/metrics), 10) Learning+Self-Regulation Layer (feedback/patterns/updates/organism). Dependency flows downward only.
umh_definition.operator_experience: Persistent workstation/Jarvis layer across devices with modes (Developer, Research, Command Center, Overnight, etc.), boot sequences, session continuity (user leaves -> system continues permitted work -> user returns -> summary + resume), approval queues, trace visibility, and progressive authority release.
umh_definition.organism_runtime: Self-regulation through homeostasis, internal signaling (InternalSignal with source_module/signal_type/severity/payload), resource allocation (compute/attention/model calls/worker cells), attention allocation, worker cell spawning, sandboxed self-update testing, cycle management (day/night/advisor/worker/review/maintenance), health monitoring, anomaly detection, and recovery. Bounded self-recursion loop: detect issue -> propose improvement -> simulate/evaluate -> sandbox -> test -> compare before/after -> request approval -> deploy -> trace -> monitor.
umh_definition.device_role_intelligence: Cross-device persistent cognition layer. VPS as persistent advisor/control node, local machine as high-compute/GUI worker, mobile as command interface, cloud as scalable fallback, sandbox/container as isolated execution cell, offline mode where possible. WorkstationProfile tracks devices, environments, modes, permissions, boot sequences, active state, active tasks, active traces, preferred execution nodes, continuity state.
umh_definition.source_truth_model: Graph-based world model with entities, relationships, state values, temporal state, and uncertainty. Every fact includes confidence, source, and timestamp. Memory is typed (working/episodic/semantic/canonical/instance/behavioral/procedural/trace-derived/profile/environment/goal/world-state/pattern/policy), governed, temporal, and source-attributed. Trace is the complete execution record (not memory). Memory candidates are derived from traces/outcomes/feedback. Canonical memory = promoted general knowledge. Instance memory = user-specific state.
umh_definition.app_relationship: UMH is the substrate. EntrepreneurOS, CreatorOS, LyfeOS, and future projections are domain-specific interfaces sitting on top. Platforms translate user intent into UMH signals, provide domain-specific views, expose workflows/dashboards, display results, collect feedback, enforce domain-specific permissions. They do NOT contain intelligence. UMH owns memory, governance, capability registry, execution spine, adapter contracts, and learning loop. The product stack: OST/HoldCo -> UMH substrate -> EOS (business) / CreatorOS (audience/content) / LyfeOS (personal life) / InvestorOS (capital) / Workstation (operator interface).
